articles.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
articles.description: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

articles.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
articles.description: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

articles.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
articles.description: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

articles.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
articles.description: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.description: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Bitcoin, crypto stocks caught in AI trade meltdown, but Wintermute trader sees 'glass half full'
articles.description: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
articles.description: A joint U.S. government statement says the hacks are affecting the food, transportation, and healthcare industries after reports of global mass hacks.

articles.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
articles.description: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

articles.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
articles.description: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

articles.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
articles.description: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.

articles.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
articles.description: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.

articles.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
articles.description: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

articles.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
articles.description: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

articles.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
articles.description: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

articles.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
articles.description: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.

articles.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist
articles.description: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

articles.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
articles.description: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

articles.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
articles.description: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

articles.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
articles.description: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.
